title: Austin's Mueller Redevelopment Budget Greenlit
meeting_type: Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board of Directors MLGC Meeting
summary:
*   City leaders, serving as the Mueller Local Government Corporation (MLGC) Board, convened specifically to address the Mueller Redevelopment Project.
*   The board approved a $2,377,143 operating budget for the Mueller project for the upcoming Fiscal Year 2010-2011.
*   This meeting's agenda primarily focused on the financial and operational management of the Mueller community's continued development.
